english.title: Participate in the criminal activities of an organised crime group
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) participated in the criminal activities, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTIVITIES..), of an organised crime group, knowing or reasonably suspecting

(A)_[they were the activities of such a group]_
(B)_[those activities would help such a group to carry on criminal activities]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 45(1) and (9) of the Serious Crime Act 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
took part in an activity / activities
knowing / reasonably suspecting
it was the criminal activity of an organised crime group OR
that the activity would help an organised crime group to carry on criminal activities

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) "Organised crime group" means a group that has as its purpose, or as one of its purposes, the carrying on of criminal activities, and consists of three or more persons who act, or agree to act, together to further that purpose.
(ii) "Criminal Activities" are defined by subsections 45(3), (4) and (5).
(iii) It is a defence for a person charged with an offence under this section to prove that the person's participation was necessary for a purpose related to the prevention or detection of crime.
(iv) For a person to be guilty of an offence under this section it is not necessary -
(a) for the person to know any of the persons who are members of the organised crime group,
(b) for all of the acts or omissions comprising participation in the group's criminal activities to take place in England and Wales (so long as at least one of them does), or
(c) for the gain or benefit referred to in subsection 45(3) to be financial in nature.
